verdict.rationale: There is independent hands-on evidence of running HGX B200 on a Linux stack: VFIO passthrough, KVM VMs, IOMMU-group allocation and Fabric Manager-managed NVSwitch partitioning. First-party docs reference nvidia-smi, Docker Engine, the NVIDIA Container Toolkit and CUDA driver APIs, but never explicitly document Linux driver releases for B200. Missing for 10: explicit documented Linux driver release notes or support matrix for B200, a dedicated independent Linux driver test or benchmark of the part, and an open Linux stack (Fabric Manager is closed source, as the author conceded).
